Wish list

Gifts in kind

Donated goods are sorted with care and handed out directly. Please write to us before dropping anything off.

  • Non-perishable foodrice, pasta, canned goods, cereal
  • Coats, boots and mittensclean, all sizes
  • School suppliesbackpacks, notebooks, pencils, calculators
  • Hygiene productssoap, toothpaste, menstrual products
  • Blankets and sleeping bagsfor winter outreach
  • Laptopsin working order, for students
Offer a gift in kind

Support us in prayer

Your support through prayer, emails and encouragement is a blessing. Share a prayer request with us or join the association’s prayer chain.

Other ways to give

  • Give your time

    Food drives, outreach, sorting, homework help: there is a place for you.

  • Tribute gift

    A birthday, a loss, a celebration: dedicate your gift to someone you love.

  • Businesses and churches

    Office drives, matching gifts, a special offering: let’s talk.
